title: An INSTEAD OF trigger whose function runs as the caller is not a write bypass

expect.note: the only real finding left: RLS is not FORCEd, so the table owner still writes every row

fix: ALTER TABLE c_invoker_trigger.submissions FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Neither the trigger nor the view needs a fix — an invoker trigger function is what case 50 is fixed *into*, and the view being a definer changes nothing, because it is the function's security attribute that decides who the write runs as.
